item.text: The switchover temperature is **35°F (about 1.7°C)**. Below that outdoor temperature, the natural gas furnace takes over heating from the heat pump. See Section 1.2.1.5 of the [ResStock 2025 Release 1 Dual Fuel Heating System documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96414.pdf#page=13).
